stem: A large established plant still receives water from one emitter placed beside the original transplant point, leaving much of the expanded root zone relatively dry. What is the strongest response?
choices: Evaluate and redistribute irrigation delivery to match the expanded active root zone while monitoring moisture uniformity
Increase fertilizer concentration at the single wet point
Pile more wet mulch against the stem
Assume roots will remain concentrated at the original emitter forever
rationale: Emitter placement and distribution should evolve with root-zone expansion so irrigation does not create one persistently saturated point and a dry surrounding volume.
